result.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService, the diff wraps refreshOAuthTokens around myGoogleAuth.refreshToken: in sync mode (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set), refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from the sync endpoint, which the code then uses as `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;`. A fetch Response has no `.data` property (unlike the gaxios response previously destructured via `const { res } = await myGoogleAuth.refreshToken(...)`), so token is undefined and accessing token.access_token throws. judged_text: In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but the Google caller immediately does res?.data and then token.access_token, treating it as a gaxios response whose .data is the parsed token body. With APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, a Google Calendar token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading access_token)' because a fetch Response has no .data property, breaking calendar reads/writes for every user with a Google credential.
